content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) for episode ep-05024, which cited absence of required precertification. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes, supporting medical necessity for the billed service. We request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 581.63, noting the service was rendered 58 days ago and the appeal is submitted within the 122 days remaining to the filing deadline."}
